name: Surreal Feather Goddess
image_vibe: divine white feather luxury, serene cinematic glamour

prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic 2:3 fashion portrait on an oversized white-feather bed with luminous editorial makeup.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman reclining gracefully on a luxurious bed of oversized white feathers, eyes closed and arms relaxed, wearing a sculpted fully covered white bodysuit with textured leaf-like appliques and a secure high neckline; sleek pulled-back hair, bronze luminous skin, gold cheek highlight, defined brows, winged liner, long lashes, and deep nude lips.
prompt.composition_elements: 2:3 portrait, feather arrangement radiating like an angelic aura, serene face and sculptural outfit as focal points, relaxed statuesque posture.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft dramatic cinematic light revealing feather texture, facial contours, natural pores, and layered appliques; divine ethereal atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 8K photorealistic fashion photography, realistic skin and feather texture, subtle editorial retouching, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic 2:3 editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman reclining gracefully on a luxurious bed of oversized white feathers, eyes closed, arms relaxed, fully covered sculpted white bodysuit with textured leaf-like appliques and secure high neckline, sleek pulled-back hair, bronze luminous makeup, gold cheek highlights, defined brows, winged eyeliner, deep nude lips, feathers radiating like an angelic aura, soft dramatic cinematic light, natural pores, tactile texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, deep neckline, exposed intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, airbrushed, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: white feather goddess reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the feather bed, serene recline, white leaf-applique couture, makeup, and soft dramatic light; keep adult fictional identity and wardrobe details replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the divine editorial concept and feather composition while using secure coverage and a clearly adult fictional identity.
